build_nose_hoover_nvt: build a NoseHooverNVT thermostat with a target temperature and damping time for NVT simulations
build_bussi_thermostat: build a BussiThermostat with a target temperature and coupling time for stochastic velocity rescaling
build_langevin_thermostat: build a LangevinThermostat with a target temperature and friction coefficient for stochastic dynamics
build_berendsen_npt: build a BerendsenNPT thermostat with temperature, pressure, and compressibility for NPT simulations
save_restore_thermostat_state: save and restore thermostat state to and from a checkpoint dict for resuming MD simulations
